title: Outside facts that age
tagline: The knowledge base learns what it cannot see
intro: This update teaches a project's knowledge base about the things it could not see before.

steps.say: A note about an outside system now carries the date it was last checked and how long that check stays good.
Once that time runs out, the routine check names the note and asks for a re-check, without going online.
The gathering step lists the moments a person corrected the agent or answered its question, and it pairs saved memories with the notes that already cover them.

outro: Facts about the world outside the code stop being trusted forever just because nobody looked again.
